response.justification: Bogdan has strong backend and distributed-systems expertise, with experience in real-time systems and AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq. However, his background lacks direct fintech or credit-risk experience, multi-agent AI systems in commercial environments, or leadership in scaling teams to 30+ engineers. His roles are primarily in general software development and consulting rather than executive fintech leadership.
strengths: Proven backend and distributed-systems expertise (real-time metadata handling at Dunnhumby, event-driven GISCollective platform)
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and tooling (MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq)
Strong engineering leadership in building and scaling teams (Altom, RIDE Capital) and developer tooling
concerns: No demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure, credit-risk systems, or embedded finance
Limited direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in production financial contexts
Lacks executive-level leadership in scaling engineering teams to 30+ engineers or governance frameworks for outsourced engineering
